skim_extract.text: Learn You Unison
This skill set helps coding agents inspect, write, test, and maintain Unison programs.
For example: “Read CODE, inspect my UCM project, and implement a tested pure function.” The agent loads the relevant specialist, checks real signatures, and verifies the result through UCM.
The canonical skills live under CODE.

For a different harness, add this instruction to its project rules: “For Unison tasks, read CODE.” Keep the bundle's CODE, CODE, CODE, and CODE paths together; references link across these directories.
Use Python 3.9 or newer and UCM.
To inspect your installed MCP contract, run this probe.
Research date: 2026-09-06.

- Source catalog: primary documentation, Share, upstream agent guidance, talks, and access limitations. - Validation report: checks executed and their limits. - Evaluation tasks: realistic prompts and observable success criteria for another harness. - Olki mapping: requirements from the neighboring CODE directory.
